<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:id="@+id/main" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="#FDFDFD">
<androidx.fragment.app.FragmentContainerView android:id="@+id/arFragment" android:name="com.google.ar.sceneform.ux.ArFragment" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"/>
<!-- Texto de loading, centralizado --> <TextView android:id="@+id/textViewMap" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Carregando mapa..." android:textColor="#32357A" android:textSize="24sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:gravity="center" android:fontFamily="@font/staatliches" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"/>
<!-- Botão escolher destino --> <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnEscolherDestino" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="ESCOLHER DESTINO" android:textAllCaps="true" android:paddingStart="16dp" android:paddingEnd="16dp" android:insetTop="0dp" android:insetBottom="0dp" android:layout_margin="16dp" app:cornerRadius="12dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"/>
<!-- Botão limpar rota --> <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnLimparRota" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="LIMPAR ROTA" android:textAllCaps="true" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp" android:insetTop="0dp" android:insetBottom="0dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" app:cornerRadius="12dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/btnEscolherDestino" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"/>
<!-- Texto da distância restante --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvDistancia" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Distância: --" android:textColor="#32357A" android:textSize="14sp" android:padding="8dp" android:background="#80000000" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/btnLimparRota" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="4dp"/>
<!-- Card lista de destinos --> <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView android:id="@+id/cardDestino" android:layout_width="250dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" app:cardElevation="8dp" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvDistancia" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="12dp">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvTituloDestino" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Escolha o destino" android:textStyle="bold" android:textSize="16sp" android:paddingBottom="4dp"/>
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/recyclerDestino" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="200dp" android:overScrollMode="ifContentScrolls"/>
</LinearLayout>
</com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
<!-- Minimap será uma View customizada no canto inferior direito --> <com.example.indoorar.ui.MinimapView android:id="@+id/minimap" android:layout_width="150dp" android:layout_height="150dp" android:background="#99000000" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" android:layout_margin="16dp" />
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
